segments.text: Hold control, say what you want, let go, it types it for you. Ghost pepper is a local holdto talk speechtoext app for Apple silicon. No cloud APIs, no audio
leaving your machine, zero latency waiting on a server. The filler word cleanup is what made it blow up on hacker news. You speak naturally. It
pastes clean text. Dictate code, write emails, talk to your local AI agents without touching the keyboard.
